descriptions.bfs: a search that explores cells in rings of increasing step count from the start, keeping discovered cells in a first-in-first-out line
descriptions.dfs: a search that follows one branch as far as it can go before backing up to the last fork, keeping discovered cells in a last-in-first-out pile
descriptions.iddfs: a search that repeats a branch-following search from the start with a step limit that grows by one each round
descriptions.astar: a search that always expands the open cell with the smallest sum of steps taken so far plus an estimate of the steps remaining to the goal
descriptions.gbfs: a search that always expands the open cell with the smallest estimate of the steps remaining to the goal, ignoring the steps taken so far
